title: Basic Water Energy 011 SVE EN Reverse Holo Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Basic Water Energy card from the Shrouded Fable set of the Pokémon TCG. This Reverse Holo card features a Water Energy character and is part of the Prismatic Evolutions series. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2024, this card is in English and has the card number 007.
